prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close on a heavy-set Black baker in his fifties standing in a doorway he has just flung open: shaved head, a broken nose, a double chin, flour on his forearms, a sweat-stained vest, his real-skinned face large in frame and off-centre left, tired eyes looking straight at the room in front of him. He holds one small pale loaf against his chest in both floury hands. Behind him a narrow corridor in cold blue light, a bare bulb far down it. In front of him, out of frame, a feast: its warm amber lamplight falls across his face and the loaf, and cigar smoke drifts past him in flat layers, catching the light. The door frame and the edge of the open door are dark in the near foreground on the right. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the amber light on his face and the loaf, and the blue corridor behind his head. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
